title: Best Qwen 3.8 27B quant/overall setup for a single RTX3090 PC.
author: Silent_Ad_1505
post_body:
Repost
Go to LocalLLaMA

2d ago
Silent_Ad_1505
Best Qwen 3.8 27B quant/overall setup for a single RTX3090 PC.
Question | Help

Here’s my treasure- RTX 3090 Turbo without thermal interface (it was a crappy old one so I had to disassemble it and invest about £40 into proper thermal pads+paste) and cooler. And it is day and night, totally worth every penny!

So the 1st question is what quant should I chose if I don’t need super-long context (no coding tasks at the moment). Also llama.cpp or vllm?
2nd one is: should I invest £500 into buying 4070ti (second hand but with CEX warranty) adding +12Gb of vram into the pool?
What would I be able to run after such upgrade?

My pc is 13700K z690 MB with proper pcie bifurcation x8/x8, 64Gb Ram

Share

I no longer treat this as an up-front choice. I have this model running on three different machines all in different ways. Give a coding agent the GPU for a night and ask it to try several different quants, vllm configs, mtp/dflash options, etc against your use case, and use the one that benches best.

Check out this repo, they give the best single 3090 performance I’ve seen. I have dual 3090s, but I still use all of the patches from this repo and W4A16 Autoround. vLLM is probably more performant than llama.cpp, though I think the gap is closer for single GPU? I can second this.  I tried ninfer-3090, unsloth studio, and the syv-ai setup.

the syv-ai setup seems to be the most complicated, but deepseek was actually able to get me setup after a little back and forth. been able to seamlessly get setup for parallel inference and have been building a vs code extension and claude code skill set to extend CC via my vs code extension and the skills which execute open code to that back end to get a comprehensive multi agent setup going.

I haven't gotten to reap world use case testing just yet, still setting up this multi harness Frankenstein monster, but its looking quite good.

For a single 3090, go 4-bit or 5-bit quant. If you're not doing heavy coding, 4-bit is plenty and keeps things snappy. As for the 4070ti, adding 12GB is a decent bump, but make sure your PSU can handle the transient spikes. Llama.cpp is usually easier for mixed-GPU setups.

comments.author: tatertots89
comments.text:
tatertots89
•
2d ago

with the new v3.0 from unsloth I run Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ4_XS.gguf only, I used to run q5 but the size has bloated a bit too much for my single 3090 (ctx <55k). Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ4_XS.gguf is incredible IMO.

Blues520
•
2d ago
 Top 1% Commenter

What kind of speeds are you getting?

tatertots89
•
2d ago

power limited to 275W for stability I'm getting ~70 tokens/s for coding and ~45 tokens/s for english problems (100k ctx, spec draft 3) on llama.cpp.

NovaXeros
•
2d ago

Do you find 100k ctx is enough for coding tasks?

Blues520
•
2d ago
 Top 1% Commenter

It's generally fine for short horizon tasks. You'll just need to start new sessions more regularly

tatertots89
•
2d ago

Most of my AI work is non coding, I can get more q8 kv ctx out of it before I need to go to q4 kv. 131k is my max on q8, 215k max on q4 kv.

I find most of my coding tasks that run out of ctx is mostly due to me being lazy and not inserting myself into the loop enough.

Blues520
•
2d ago
 Top 1% Commenter

That's fast! Do you mind sharing your llama configuration please?

tatertots89
•
2d ago

You can fit more than 102k ctx, I lower it because I run a faster-whisper server on gpu simultaneously.

u/echo off

llama-server.exe ^

--model "Qwen3.8-27B-UD-IQ4_XS.gguf" ^

--mmproj "mmproj-BF16.gguf" ^

--spec-draft-model "mtp-Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_0.gguf" ^

--spec-type draft-mtp ^

--spec-draft-n-max 3 ^

--host xxx ^

--port xxx ^

--gpu-layers 99 ^

--cache-type-k q8_0 ^

--cache-type-v q8_0 ^

--ctx-size 102400 ^

--batch-size 4096 ^

--ubatch-size 1024 ^

--threads 16 ^

--flash-attn on ^

--reasoning-effort medium ^

--reasoning-budget 32768 ^

--parallel 1 ^

--jinja ^

--chat-template-file "chat_template.jinja" ^

--alias "3.8-27b q4 q8 102k" ^

--temp 0.7 ^

--repeat-penalty 1.05 ^

--top-p 0.95 ^

--top-k 40 ^

--min-p 0.02 ^

--presence-penalty 0.05 ^

--frequency-penalty 0.05

pause
